ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed: Forwarded") && ISBLANK(Forward_To_Email__c) && ISBLANK(Forward_To_Email_Calculation__c) && NOT(ISPICKVAL( Forward_To_Unit__c , 'ServiceNow') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A "Closed: Forwarded" Case must have a recipient. Either enter a "Forward to Unit" or enter "Other Unit" for 'Forward to Unit' and a forward Email.
